tasks.short: Inspect products, containers and packing quality

steps.what: Identify the applicable product quality and packing specifications
Examine and inspect containers, materials and products for quality and packing conformance

tasks.design: Keep product and container inspection with the packager, using existing specifications from {OPS_SYSTEM} or {DOCS}. No camera, structured defect detector or automated release is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packing quality depends on physical condition and order-specific requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing specification access supports inspection without replacing it.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage, unsuitable materials and unusual packaging combinations.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a pack that meets a simple checklist but will not protect the product.
tasks.altitude: Inspection time and responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Physical packing inspection requires observations that an order record alone does not provide.

assumptions: Boundary covers identifying criteria and examining items, not physical repacking or final shipment release.
Existing packing planner produces the order and released specification outside this boundary; packager checks applicability in s1 and produces observations during s2 with all time retained.
No structured defect code is required by a machine action. Native access remains sufficient and earns no new saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because there is no new inspection tool, feed or rule set.
research_questions: Which packing defects require touch, movement or opening a container to detect?

already_counted.description: Check criteria and inspect products and packing physically

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain all applicability checks and physical inspection rather than treating an order record as evidence of packing quality.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record product, packaging and order information

steps.what: Identify the order, products, packed quantities and packaging details at the packing station
Record product, packaging and order information on the specified forms and records
Check packing records and resolve quantity, product or packaging mismatches

tasks.design: Capture the verified packing details once in {OPS_SYSTEM} using scans and explicit quantity or packaging entries. Native record layouts populate the required forms from that captured event, while the packager keeps all identification and exception checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Details are identified at the station and then copied into a separate packing form.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scan capture and packing records can reuse one event without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Short packs, unreadable labels and distinguishing the actual pack from the planned order.
tasks.human_edge: Check what is physically packed rather than accept a planned quantity as fact.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate recording; responsibility for accurate packing details stays with the packager.

reach.task: Reconcile a packing-record mismatch before dispatch
reach.learn: Order identifiers, packing units and exception handling

evidence.claim: Boltrics 3PL Dynamics is a warehouse management system with transport and related logistics modules; this supports the system category, not a measured pack-record saving.
A packing capture event can populate native record layouts without duplicate transcription if actual quantities and packaging are explicitly captured.

assumptions: Boundary is packager identification, recording and checking, not packing itself, picking, loading or dispatch authorisation. Overlapping outbound-record tasks must be allocated once in a team roll-up.

Packager produces order id, item id, actual packed quantity, unit, package id and packaging type in s1 by scanning or manual entry. Its entire 45 hours remain to cover identification, scanning, quantity capture and unreadable-label fallback; no free structured packing event is assumed.

Existing order planner supplies order id and planned lines before packing outside this task. Planned quantities never substitute for actual packed quantities. Package sequence ids may be assigned by the system only after packager capture.
s2 writes the record only after required captured fields are present. Missing fields or unavailable native forms use manual record entry within the lower scenario, not a guessed default.

Test native station forms and layouts before code. New mapping maintenance is costed below. No scanner-derived worker ranking or task allocation is introduced; employee-linked capture needs appropriate local consultation and access controls.
s2 saves transcription only; existing runtime earns no labour saving, and s3 retains all record review and exception time.
unknowns: Existing scan capture and required package fields
Fraction of unreadable or unlabelled items
research_questions: Can the captured event reproduce every required packing field without relying on the planned quantity?

already_counted.description: Identify and capture actual packing details and check the resulting record

incremental.description: Maintain package-field mappings and check failed record generation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+0+20=65; gross 35 minus upkeep 2 gives net 33. E1 scenario removes only a duplicate form-writing step after fully counted capture. Unsupported layouts or manual fallbacks can absorb the gain; physical packing and checks are untouched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain, move and sort packing products and materials

steps.what: Obtain and move products, materials, containers and orders using hand tools
Sort products, materials, containers and orders into their required packing groups

tasks.design: Retain manual obtaining, movement and sorting with existing hand tools. Instructions from {OPS_SYSTEM} may remain available, but no physical automation or transfer of handling to another worker is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Software cannot move or separate the varied materials without additional equipment and process redesign.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology is needed for this unchanged handling task.
tasks.still_hard: Awkward items, obstructed routes and mixed materials.
tasks.human_edge: Handle varied products carefully and adjust the sequence to the physical workspace.
tasks.altitude: Handling time and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Arrange a safe staging sequence for mixed packing materials
reach.learn: Load limits, routes and staging constraints

evidence.claim: Physical movement and sorting remain hand work without additional handling equipment or process redesign.

assumptions: Boundary is manual movement and grouping at packing, not outbound record keeping or powered material-handling equipment operation.
Packing planner produces existing instructions outside this task. Packager reads labels and handles items within the retained steps; no structured routing input drives a machine action.
Native instruction access is unchanged. Zero incremental upkeep because no new routing logic, scanner workflow or handling equipment is introduced.
Physical handling that overlaps other material-moving tasks must be allocated once in a roll-up.
research_questions: Which movements are constrained by physical layout rather than missing information?

already_counted.description: Obtain, move and physically sort packing materials

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain all movement and sorting; no physical work disappears through record automation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The packager can avoid duplicate packing records while retaining inspection and all physical handling.
reach: Coordinate safe material staging with material movers
skills_to_grow: Capturing actual rather than planned quantities
role.ambitious_version: A packager whose record reflects what was actually packed without a second transcription step.
